info.name: KaraokeSing | ITEC 116
info.description: Set adminUsername, adminPassword, staffUsername and staffPassword in a local Postman environment. Run in order. The collection generates its demo credentials and IDs and removes its demo records.

exec: pm.test('Only singers and no passwords', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (user) { pm.expect(user.role).to.eql('singer'); pm.expect(user).to.not.have.property('password'); }); });
pm.test('Created genre is listed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(genre => genre.genreId)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('genreId'))); });
pm.test('Owner is taken from JWT', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().userId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('singerId'))); });
pm.test('Created request is listed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(request => request.requestId)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('requestId'))); });
pm.test('Playing entry is listed', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(entry => entry.queueId)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('queueId'))); });
pm.test('Completed entry is absent', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(entry => entry.queueId)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('queueId'))); });
